name: Navatalgordo (Spain)
description: Four equal vertical stripes of green, white, red and yellow, charged at the centre, over the white and red stripes, with the crowned municipal arms of Navatalgordo (a tree, a sheaf of wheat and a sheep).
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 5 January 1999 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 21 of 2 February 1999); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of four equal vertical stripes, green, white, red and yellow from the hoist to the fly, with the municipal arms at the centre over the white and red stripes.

features.role: Navatalgordo arms — tree, sheaf and sheep
